# Gene (`gene` v1)

A human gene: location on GRCh38, transcripts, expression by tissue and its known variants.

**Group:** Genomics and biology · **Mnemonic:** `GENE` · **Identifiers:** `GENE-…` in `geneId`

Open one with `GENE <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: gene
version: 1
description: "A human gene: location on GRCh38, transcripts, expression by tissue and its known variants."
match: { kind: gene, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Genomics and biology · Gene, id: $.geneId }
strip:
  - { label: Symbol, bind: $.symbol, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Name, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Location, bind: $.location }
  - { label: Length (bp), bind: $.length, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Strand, bind: $.strand }
  - { label: Transcripts, bind: $.transcripts, fmt: amount0 }
panels:
  - id: expression
    kind: hbar
    title: Expression by tissue (TPM)
    key: F2
    rows: $.expression
    label: tissue
    value: tpm
    fmt: price2
  - id: variants
    kind: table
    title: Known variants
    key: F3
    rows: $.variants
    columns:
      - { label: Variant, bind: "@.id" }
      - { label: Protein change, bind: "@.protein" }
      - { label: Significance, bind: "@.significance" }
  - id: identifiers
    kind: kv
    title: Identifiers
    area: right
    rows: $.identifiers
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.protein, 'protein')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
